objects.name: Detection technique coverage: cisco-secure-firewall-rare-snort-rule-triggered
objects.description: This analytic identifies Snort signatures that have triggered only once in the past 7 days across all Cisco Secure Firewall IntrusionEvent logs. While these rules typically do not trigger in day-to-day network activity, their sudden appearance may indicate early-stage compromise, previously unseen malware, or reconnaissance activity against less commonly exposed services. Investigating these outliers can provide valuable insight into new or low-noise adversary behaviors.
